title: Nice Quality
text: Nice Quality. This shower curtain is a nice quality. It isn't thin or cheap feeling. It looks just like the picture.

product_metadata.title: Scamzsure White Shower Curtain Liner Plastic Heavy Duty Bathroom Curtains with Three Brown Weighted Stones,Rustproof Metal Grommets,Waterproof & Machine Washable,72x72 Inch
features: 【Dimensions】:70.9 inches width,70.9 inches hight (180x180cm) fits most shower stalls.

【Material】:The shower curtain is made of EVA material,which is odorless and waterproof,so that the water droplets formed during the shower drip down the curtain to the ground,thus keeping the rest of the bathroom dry.
【Weighted Hem】:The bottom of the shower curtain has two weighted brown stones to prevent attacking human bodies in the shower.

【Convenient and Durable】:This shower curtain is very convenient to use,whether it is a straight rod or a curved rod,it can be easily installed.The rust-proof metal grommets on the top of the shower curtain prevents it from tearing,and make it last long.

【Multi-purpose】:Shower curtain can not only be used as a shower curtain alone, but also can be used as a shower curtain liner with other shower curtains,which can be used in bathrooms,bathtubs,spas,hotels,RVs,gyms and other places.
